description: Can this homework be done by an AI? For teachers and schools: paste an assignment (or a public PDF URL) and get an overall AI-completion risk 0-100, a per-question breakdown (risk, why, concrete fix to make it AI-resistant) and general tips. No student data. Input: text or url, optional grade, subject, lang fr|en. / Ce devoir peut-il être fait par une IA? Score par question et corrections concrètes pour l'enseignant. Costs $0.25 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base). Send the HTTP header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE with your x402 payment, or call POST https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/homework-check with an x402 client.

url.description: Public URL of the assignment (PDF or page)
